local sword = {

["midnight asura"] = 34073,

macro(100, "Change Sword", function()
    if not g_game.isAttacking() then return end
    local Utarget = g_game.getAttackingCreature()
    for key, value in pairs(sword) do
        if Utarget and sword[Utarget:getName():lower()] then
            if not getLeft() or getLeft():getId() ~= tonumber(value) then
                moveToSlot(sword[Utarget:getName():lower()], SlotLeft)
            end
        end
    end
end)
